links.comparator_used: Linear multi-agent pipeline, where audit findings are not routed back to the summary agent, plus single-agent and naive RAG modes
links.outcome: Guideline Compliance Score (GCS) under knowledge base distribution shift
links.effect: Stateful graph with safety floor kept GCS = 1.00 across all shift conditions. The linear pipeline's GCS fell from 1.00 to 0.36 under institutional vocabulary shift. The pattern held across both LLM backends and both embedding models.
links.tradeoff: Added latency: 32.2s per patient under shift versus 12.5s for single-agent mode.
links.quote: The stateful graph architecture maintained GCS = 1.00 across all shift conditions through its regime-aware safety floor, which operates independently of retrieval quality.

design_hint: programmatic safety floor with audit-feedback loop in multi-agent LLM system
